## About
Quality Coach Collision is a full service collision repair facility on Axtell Dr in Troy, working with Birmingham neighbors and their insurances. We repair collision damage on all foreign and domestic cars, trucks, SUVs and vans, for commercial and non-commercial customers.
Jeff, the owner, usually answers the phone himself, and if he can't, he calls you right back. We'll explain the process, keep you informed of any changes during your repair, and make sure you understand how the insurance side works.
Customers have given us a 4.9 rating from 191 Google reviews. One customer wrote that they always feel better stepping out of the shop, even before the work is done. That's the feeling we want you to leave with.

## Services
- Collision Repair: Collision damage repaired on foreign and domestic cars, trucks, SUVs and vans.
- Insurance Claim Assistance: We'll explain the insurance process and help you through your claim.
- Towing Assistance to Our Facility: Help getting your vehicle to our shop after an accident.
- Rental Car Assistance: Help with a rental while your car is in for repair.
- Mechanical Repairs Associated With Collision: The mechanical work that comes along with collision damage.
- Windshield and Auto Glass Replacement Assistance: Help getting damaged windshields and glass replaced.
- Expert Paint Matching: Paint that matches the rest of your car, so the repair doesn't stand out.
- Thorough White Glove Final Inspection: A careful last look at the work before your car goes home.

## FAQ
Q: Do you offer free estimates?
A: Yes. Estimates are free and by appointment only, so give us a call to set one up.

Q: What kinds of vehicles do you repair?
A: We repair collision damage on all foreign and domestic cars, trucks, SUVs and vans, for commercial and non-commercial customers.

Q: Can you help me with my insurance claim?
A: Yes. We'll explain the process and make sure you understand how the insurance side works before and during your repair.
